verdict.rationale: Wave is accounting software, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent features: auto-categorizing bank transactions, OCR extraction of receipt data, and standard reports with month-to-month and year-to-year comparisons. None of these is documented as AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
